speechEnhancement.title: Speech Enhancement
speechEnhancement.info: Speech Enhancement improves speech recognition accuracy by correcting low-confidence words. This is separate from the voice model selection.
speechEnhancement.description: Automatically suggests corrections for unclear words during speech recognition. Ideal for users with speech impairments.
speechEnhancement.sensitivityDesc: Lower sensitivity suggests corrections for more words. Higher sensitivity only suggests corrections for very unclear words.

welcome.title: Welcome to Speech Link!
welcome.message: Let's take a quick tour to help you get started with the app's main features.

createSentence.title: Create Your Sentence
createSentence.message: Tap here to create your first custom sentence. You can add any phrase you use frequently.

categoryButton.title: Organize by Categories
categoryButton.message: Tap this button to access and manage your categories. Keep your sentences organized for easy access.

selectCategory.title: Choose a Category
selectCategory.message: Select 'Basic Needs' or create your own custom categories to organize your sentences effectively.

organizeSentences.title: Organize Your Sentences
organizeSentences.message: Keep your sentences in categories to find them quickly when you need them. Drag and drop to reorder!

voiceCollection.title: Try & Choose Your Voice
voiceCollection.message: Explore our voice collection and find the perfect voice that fits you best. Preview any voice before selecting it.

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation Dictionary
pronunciation.message: If a word doesn't sound right, add it here! For example: 'OpenAPI' → 'Open A P I'. Customize how words are pronounced.

settingsLanguage.title: Select Your Language
settingsLanguage.message: Change the app's language here. We support multiple languages to make Speech Link accessible to everyone.

settingsAudioOutput.title: Choose Audio Output
settingsAudioOutput.message: Keep the audio on your phone speaker even when Bluetooth headphones are connected. Perfect for communication!

settingsHideDefaults.title: Hide Default Sentences
settingsHideDefaults.message: Speech Link provides basic sentences to get you started. You can hide them to display only your custom sentences.

settingsDiscord.title: Discord Integration
settingsDiscord.message: Use Speech Link in Discord! Discuss with people online using your synthesized voice in voice channels.

settingsSubscription.title: Choose Your Plan
settingsSubscription.message: Select the subscription plan that fits your needs. Different plans offer various features and usage limits.

complete.title: You're All Set!
complete.message: You're ready to start using Speech Link. Remember, you can replay this tutorial anytime from Settings.

skipConfirm.title: Skip Tutorial?
skipConfirm.message: You can replay this tutorial anytime from the Settings menu.
